notes: 2026-08-29 (branch `chore/drop-jest-native`, stacked on `fix/react-test-renderer-pin` #494 -> `chore/normalize-lock-npm10` #495) — DROPPED the deprecated `@testing-library/jest-native@5.4.3` from apps/mobile: one manifest line, -117 lock lines, ZERO test-code changes. npm prints the deprecation on every install ("use the built-in Jest matchers available in @testing-library/react-native v12.4+"), and mobile already carries react-native@13.3.3. ⚠️ THERE WAS NOTHING TO MIGRATE — jest-native was never wired up: `apps/mobile/jest.config.js` has NO `setupFiles`/`setupFilesAfterEach`/`setupFilesAfterEnv` key at all, no jest setup file exists on disk, and NEITHER @testing-library package is imported anywhere under `__tests__/`. So `extend-expect` was never loaded and no jest-native matcher was ever callable; this is a pure manifest deletion, not a migration. Measured across four from-scratch resolutions: both TL packages + no pin -> ERESOLVE (via jest-native >=16.0.0); jest-native removed + no pin -> STILL ERESOLVE (via react-native >=18.2.0); both TL packages removed + no pin -> resolves; pin present -> resolves. Freeing the pin would mean deleting the sanctioned component-testing library to save one manifest line — bad trade.
